summary: The Claude channel boot canaries can run with a shorter attach window and recovery backoff; production values are unchanged unless the new ST3_CLAUDE_ATTACH_WINDOW_MS or ST3_CLAUDE_CHANNEL_BACKOFF_MS is set to a smaller value

replay.detail: No stored history or replay change.

schema.detail: No database, claim or configuration schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Both variables can only shorten the defaults (20 s window, 10 s base backoff); unset, behavior is identical.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the two variables; nothing stored depends on them.
